title: Shemazhichuan liquid alleviates airway remodeling by modulating mitochondrial dysfunction via the EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS pathway.
authors: Zhang, Miaofen; Wang, Ting; Rao, Ling; Huang, Huiting; Liao, Gang; Liang, Huiqiu; Peng, Xiaoyun; Luo, Zhiyan; Jiang, Yong; Zhan, Shaofeng; Huang, Xiufang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS通路缓解哮喘气道重塑，核心为线粒体功能障碍与氧化应激，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Airway remodeling is a pivotal pathological driver of asthma progression. Shemazhichuan Liquid (SMZCL), a traditional Chinese herbal formulation, has demonstrated clinical efficacy against asthma, but its underlying molecular mechanisms, particularly regarding airway remodeling, remain to be fully elucidated. PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic effects of SMZCL on airway remodeling in asthma and to elucidate the potential molecular mechanisms involved. METHODS: A house dust mite (HDM)-induced asthma mouse model and an epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) cell model were used to evaluate the effects of SMZCL. Histological, biochemical and molecular analyses were performed to assess airway inflammation and remodeling. The chemical constituents of SMZCL were characterized by UHPLC-MS/MS, while network pharmacology and bioinformatics were used to predict key targets and pathways, which were further validated in vivo and in vitro. The functional role of EIF4E was further investigated using AAV-mediated shRNA knockdown in mouse lungs. RESULTS: SMZCL alleviated key asthmatic hallmarks, including inflammatory cell infiltration, mucus secretion, and collagen deposition. It also reduced serum IgE levels, pulmonary cytokine/chemokine profiles, and leukocyte counts in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), alongside decreasing airway resistance (RI) and improving lung compliance (Cdyn). Furthermore, SMZCL effectively suppressed the EMT process. A total of 162 chemical constituents were identified, and the key targets were predominantly enriched in mitochondrial, oxidative stress and the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway, with EIF4E emerging as a top candidate. Molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) confirmed a strong binding affinity between EIF4E and two SMZCL-derived compounds, irisflorentin and irigenin. Functional studies further demonstrated that SMZCL mitigated mitochondrial structural damage, enhanced ATP content, mtDNA copy number, and mitochondrial membrane potential, thereby ameliorating mitochondrial dysfunction. In addition, SMZCL reduced oxidative stress by reducing EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS signaling cascade (evidenced by decreased p-EIF4E, HIF-1alpha, ROS, p-p65, p-IkappaBalpha, IL-6, and TNF-alpha), leading to reduced levels of 8-OHdG and MDA, while increasing SOD and GPx activity. Notably, AAV-mediated EIF4E silencing mimicked the protective effects of SMZCL by inhibiting the EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS signaling axis, thereby restoring mitochondrial dysfunction, suppressing oxidative stress and EMT progression to attenuate airway remodeling. CONCLUSION: SMZCL attenuates airway remodeling in asthma by suppressing EMT, a process mediated through the inhibition of the EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS signaling axis, thereby improving mitochondrial dysfunction and reducing oxidative stress. These findings position SMZCL as a promising therapeutic candidate for asthma airway remodeling.
abstract_zh: 背景：气道重塑是哮喘进展的关键病理驱动因素。蛇麻子喘液（SMZCL）作为一种传统中药制剂，已显示出对哮喘的临床疗效，但其潜在分子机制，特别是涉及气道重塑的机制，仍有待充分阐明。目的：本研究旨在评估SMZCL对哮喘气道重塑的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法：使用屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的哮喘小鼠模型和上皮-间质转化（EMT）细胞模型来评估SMZCL的作用。通过组织学、生化和分子分析评估气道炎症和重塑。采用UHPLC-MS/MS表征SMZCL的化学成分，同时利用网络药理学和生物信息学预测关键靶点和通路，并在体内和体外进一步验证。通过AAV介导的shRNA敲低小鼠肺中EIF4E，进一步研究其功能作用。结果：SMZCL缓解了哮喘的关键特征，包括炎症细胞浸润、黏液分泌和胶原沉积。它还降低了血清IgE水平、肺部细胞因子/趋化因子谱以及支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中的白细胞计数，同时降低气道阻力（RI）并改善肺顺应性（Cdyn）。此外，SMZCL有效抑制了EMT过程。共鉴定出162种化学成分，关键靶点主要富集于线粒体、氧化应激和HIF-1alpha信号通路，其中EIF4E成为首要候选靶点。分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）证实EIF4E与SMZCL来源的两种化合物鸢尾黄素和鸢尾苷元之间具有强结合亲和力。功能研究进一步表明，SMZCL减轻了线粒体结构损伤，增强了ATP含量、mtDNA拷贝数和线粒体膜电位，从而改善线粒体功能障碍。此外，SMZCL通过减少EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS信号级联（表现为p-EIF4E、HIF-1alpha、ROS、p-p65、p-IkappaBalpha、IL-6和TNF-alpha降低）来减轻氧化应激，导致8-OHdG和MDA水平降低，同时增加SOD和GPx活性。值得注意的是，AAV介导的EIF4E沉默通过抑制EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS信号轴模拟了SMZCL的保护作用，从而恢复线粒体功能障碍、抑制氧化应激和EMT进程，以减轻气道重塑。结论：SMZCL通过抑制EMT减轻哮喘中的气道重塑，该过程通过抑制EIF4E/HIF-1alpha/ROS信号轴介导，从而改善线粒体功能障碍并减少氧化应激。这些发现将SMZCL定位为哮喘气道重塑的有前景的治疗候选药物。
